name: io.github.mwieczorkiewicz/opcua-mcp
title: OPC-UA MCP Server
description: Read, write, browse, search, and subscribe to live data on an OPC-UA industrial automation server.

environmentVariables.name: OPCUA_ENDPOINT
environmentVariables.description: OPC-UA server endpoint to connect to, e.g. opc.tcp://your-plc-host:4840

environmentVariables.name: OPCUA_AUTH_MODE
environmentVariables.description: Authentication mode against the OPC-UA server

environmentVariables.name: OPCUA_SECURITY_POLICY
environmentVariables.description: OPC-UA transport security policy, e.g. Basic256Sha256

environmentVariables.name: OPCUA_SECURITY_MODE
environmentVariables.description: OPC-UA transport security mode, e.g. SignAndEncrypt

environmentVariables.name: SERVER_TRANSPORT
environmentVariables.description: MCP transport: stdio (for local MCP clients) or http (for remote/hosted deployments)
